moc.chu: In 1821, Alexis Bouvard had published astronomical tables of the orbit of Uranus
On 31 August, Le Verrier presented a third memoir, now giving the mass and orbit of the new body.
Galle received Le Verrier's letter in the morning of 23 September.
It did not take long before d'Arrest exclaimed: "That star is not on the map!"
In François Arago's apt phrase, Le Verrier had discovered a planet "with the point of his pen".
